name: De Profundis Cordis
source:
She carries the light. You carry the choice.

In a dungeon with no doors, a forgotten hero and a knowing girl search for a way out.

[From [url=https://cottonbell.itch.io/deprofundiscordis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
她带着光。你有选择权。

在一个没有门的地牢里，一位被遗忘的英雄和一位懂事的女孩寻找出路。

[来自[url=https://cottonbell.itch.io/deprofundiscordis]itch.io[/url]]
